36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
249404: Monica Everett is famously known as the Silent Witch for being the only human capable of casting spells without chanting. Exceedingly shy, she had trouble conversing with others; and in the worst cases, faints when meeting strangers.
344106: Monica's familiar. Although it has the appearance of a black cat, it can understand and speak human language. When Monica looks distressed, it will let her touch its paws to soothe her. It has trouble remembering the names of humans other than Monica.
344107: A doctor and Louis's wife. Is aware of her husband's awful hobbies.
344108: He is one of the Seven Sages, the Barrier Mage. He was chosen as one of the Seven Sages at the same time as Monica, so he calls her "colleague".
344109: A high-ranking wind spirit who has made a contract with the Barrier Mage. Her nickname is "Ryn". She usually appears as a maid, but can also take on other forms. She acts as a liaison between Monica and Louis, and supports Monica on her top-secret mission.
344110: A first-year student in the high school division at Serendia Academy, she is the daughter of Count Kerbeck.
344112: Isabelle's maid, though Isabelle sees her more like an elder sister. The two of them often get excited talking about romance novels. Very physically capable and doubles as Isabelle's bodyguard.
344113: Agatha’s younger brother, a stable boy.
359150: The second prince of the Kingdom of Ridill. He is a third-year student in the high school division of Serendia Academy, one of the most prestigious schools in the Kingdom of Ridill, and serves as student council president.
359899: A second-year student in the high school division at Serendia Academy, she is Monica's classmate. Her father is a wealthy merchant, and her family rose to the ranks of baron, so some of her classmates and nobles mock her and call her a "nouveau riche".
360543: Vice-president of the Student Council at Serendia Academy. A third-year student in the high school division. Born to a father of marquess descent and a mother of commoner origins.
361396: Secretary of the Student Council at Serendia Academy. A third-year student in the high school division.
362311: Neil is in charge of general affairs for the student council at Serendia Academy. He is the son of Baron Maywood, a member of the "family of mediators" who mediate and negotiate on various matters. He is in his second year at the same high school as Monica.
362919: Secretary of the student council at Serendia Academy. Daughter of Marquess Shaleberry. Excellent grades and fluent in languages. Her actions and behavior are said to always be perfect, and she is one of the three most beautiful women at the school.
364157: A second-year student in the high school division at Serendia Academy. Daughter of Count Bright, whose territory borders the eastern border of the kingdom.
368135: Daughter of Marquess Hightown and a second-year student at Serendia Academy. She is Cyril's adoptive sister and Neil's fiancée.
368752: A spirited young girl residing in the village near Monica's hut. She usually takes it upon herself to deliver things to Monica.
369281: Monica’s father. A scholar who was executed seven years ago for allegedly conducting forbidden research.
369282: A second-year student at Serendia Academy. She is the representative for the health committee in Monica's class.
369284: The former student council accountant at Serendia Academy. He was caught embezzling student council funds and was thus expulsed from the school.
369980: A second-year student in the high school division at Serendia Academy. Daughter of Count Norn.
373831: Mary Harvey is the Starseer Witch of the Seven Sages, and is the Kingdom of Ridill's greatest astrologist and foremost prophet.
375348: Monica's former friend from Minerva's Mage Training Institution.
376719: The owner of a used bookstore in Corlapton. Also writes novels under the pen name Dustin Gunther. He was a friend of Monica’s father, Venedict.
403610: A teacher at Minerva’s Mage Training Institution and a high mage. Nicknamed the Mage of Violet Smoke, he is Louis’s master and Monica’s former teacher. Can use a unique spell that imbues his pipe’s smoke with mana.
